procurement_trigger.description: How often Agent 1 + 2 run. Options: manual, daily (1), every_2_days (2), weekly (7)

scheduling.analyst_trigger_description: Agent 3 generates initial waste report at this time (e.g. 1h before closing)
scheduling.pickup_deadline_description: After this time, Agent 3 updates the waste report with what was NOT picked up
scheduling.post_pickup_description: Minutes after pickup_deadline to wait before generating final report and feeding back to Agent 1

supplier_config.description: user_provided = use suppliers.json manually maintained by owner. auto_fetch = scrape/API from wholesaler sites.
